subject: FinTechCorp post-incident: RCA, timeline, and verification steps
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alejandra Soto <alejandra@fintechcorp.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-22T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Initial post-incident summary and next steps

Hi Alejandra / Tom —

Thanks again for the patience during yesterday's elevated token latency window. As promised during our call, I'm sending a concise summary of what we've found so far and the immediate actions we've scheduled. This is an initial communication while we finish the full artifact set for your auditors.

Quick summary:
- Impact: Increased generation latency and occasional 5xxs for 10:47–11:23 PDT on 2027-08-21 affecting ~18% of requests to model rwd-8b-prod in us-west-2.
- Customer-facing symptoms: delayed responses and retries visible on your dashboards; no data exfiltration indicators found.
- Current status: All traffic was routed to fallback capacity by 11:27 PDT; normal service restored by 11:31 PDT.

Immediate next steps (today):
1) We will deliver an RCA summarizing root cause, timeline, and mitigations by EOD 2027-08-22 (attached as a draft).
2) Action register with owners and target completion dates (attached).
3) Request logs bundle for your security team (attached).

Please confirm if we should include anyone else on the distribution for the final artifacts. We are tracking a formal verification window next week (monitored replay) and would like to confirm a time that works for FinTechCorp.

Attachments: ftc-rca-timeline.pdf (draft), ftc-action-register.xlsx, request-logs-20270822.tar.gz

Regards,
Monica Patel
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183
Redwood Inference

From: Alejandra Soto <alejandra@fintechcorp.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@fintechcorp.com>, FinTechCorp Security Team <security@fintechcorp.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial post-incident summary and next steps

Thanks Monica — this is helpful. A few quick asks from our side: 

- Can you expand the timeline with exact node IDs that hit the error threshold? Our security team needs mapping to the request logs.
- Please include any autoscaler/placement decisions taken automatically during the event and who has owner-level access to those policies.
- For the verification window, Fri 08/27 10:00–11:00 PDT works for our infra team. Are you able to join?

Also, we'll need a redacted copy of the request payloads for internal audit; point us to the secure share for transfer.

Alejandra
Director, Platform Ops | FinTechCorp
alejandra@fintechcorp.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alejandra Soto <alejandra@fintechcorp.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-22T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial post-incident summary and next steps

Alejandra — appreciated. Attached is the updated RCA draft with an expanded timeline and the action register populated with owners and ETA. Key items called out in the doc: 

- Root cause (summary): A mis-tuned placement heuristic in the autoscaler caused an uneven shard distribution under a sudden tail of long-context requests from a third-party integration. That increased KV-cache misses and triggered our protection circuit which delayed request serving and led to backlog and transient 5xx failures.
- Why this reached customer impact: The protection circuit correctly limited new inflight load, but combined with a slow-to-scale GPU placement path resulted in user-facing latency.
- Mitigations applied during incident: emergency routing to pre-warmed fallback pools, manual override of the placement policy, and cache warmup scripts executed by infra at 11:16–11:25 PDT.

We've added the node IDs and the autoscaler policy versions to the timeline appendix (see page 4). The secure log bundle has been placed on the drive link below; the tarball includes redaction metadata and a short README for your auditors.

Verification window: Fri 2027-08-27 10:00 PDT confirmed on our side; I'll include Sean (runtime lead) and Laura (CS) for the session. Expect a calendar invite shortly.

Attachments: ftc-rca-timeline.pdf (updated), ftc-action-register.xlsx
Links: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/ftc/rca-20270822

Regards,
Monica Patel
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Alejandra Soto <alejandra@fintechcorp.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-23T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Additional corrective commitments and timeline

Alejandra / Team — following up from our internal technical review, two additional items we are committing to: 

1) By 2027-09-03: Deploy an improved placement heuristic that reduces variance for long-context workloads; we will run a canary against a synthetic workload representative of your traffic.
2) By 2027-08-30: Add an automated cache-warmup step during scaling events for the most common model variants you use.

We will include test metrics and a short runbook for your SREs to validate during the verification window. Monica will keep you updated on owner assignments in the action register.

- Markus Klein
VP, Infrastructure & Reliability | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@fintechcorp.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alejandra Soto <alejandra@fintechcorp.com>, FinTechCorp Security Team <security@fintechcorp.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-24T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial post-incident summary and next steps

Thanks — this looks good. A couple of quick confirmations from our side before the verification: 

- We received the drive bundle and verified the redaction README; the mapping to node IDs is sufficient.
- For the canary, please include the exact workload script and expected metric thresholds so we can mirror in our staging.
- Security asks that the final RCA include the list of accounts with console access to the autoscaler for the last 90 days. Can you include that in the final artifacts?

We will join the verification window on 08/27 10:00 PDT. Please send the calendar invite and the DocuSign form for the compliance attestation so our legal team can sign off.

Tom Ellis
Head of Infrastructure | FinTechCorp
Tom.Ellis@fintechcorp.com
